title: निष्पक्ष समझ एवं मानवता प्रशिक्षण केंद्र
purpose: Develop and assess practical skills in impartial listening, evidence handling, ethical reasoning, lawful referral, safeguarding and environmental responsibility.

scope.role: Education and practice only. Graduates may support community education, mediation referrals or project administration only within applicable law and their demonstrated competence.
scope.selection: Open, transparent and non-discriminatory; do not require wealth, token ownership, political allegiance, religious belief or personal loyalty.
scope.access: No fees or certificate conditions may deny emergency food, healthcare, shelter, education or legal aid.

curriculum.name: निष्पक्ष सुनना
learning_outcomes: Listen to all affected parties without prejudging
Separate observation, allegation, inference and opinion
Use accessible language and reasonable accommodation

curriculum.name: सबूत और सत्यापन
learning_outcomes: Preserve source, timestamp, provenance and chain of custody
Distinguish a hash from proof that an event is true
Record uncertainty, missing evidence and dissent

curriculum.name: हित-संघर्ष और पक्षपात
learning_outcomes: Disclose personal, financial and institutional conflicts
Recuse when impartiality may reasonably be questioned
Use structured counter-evidence review

curriculum.name: मानवाधिकार और विधिसम्मत प्रक्रिया
learning_outcomes: Respect dignity, equality, privacy and due process
Recognize limits of competence and refer legal matters to qualified professionals
Protect complaint, appeal and correction rights

curriculum.name: सुरक्षा और गोपनीयता
learning_outcomes: Protect children and vulnerable people
Obtain informed consent for optional media
Minimize personal data and secure sensitive records

curriculum.name: जीव, वनस्पति और पृथ्वी संरक्षण
learning_outcomes: Assess environmental impacts using credible evidence
Avoid overstating outcomes from photographs or testimonials
Use proportionate, measurable project indicators

curriculum.name: संवाद, मध्यस्थता और उचित संदर्भ
learning_outcomes: Facilitate voluntary dialogue without coercion
Recognize power imbalance and unsafe mediation situations
Refer disputes to lawful, qualified services

curriculum.name: जवाबदेही और सार्वजनिक रिपोर्टिंग
learning_outcomes: Publish redacted summaries and correction histories
Keep planned, funded, delivered and verified counters separate
Report failures and unresolved complaints honestly

assessment.pass_rule: Publish transparent rubric and minimum competency thresholds before enrollment; require reassessment for failed competencies.
assessment.independent_assessment: At least two assessors who are not the learner's close associates and who disclose conflicts; use a third reviewer for contested outcomes.
assessment.certificate: A training-completion record only; it is not a professional license, judicial appointment, legal credential or proof of perfect impartiality.

supervised_practice.scope: Non-adjudicative learning, evidence organization, community education and referrals under qualified supervision.

trainer_pathway.eligibility: Demonstrated subject competence, safeguarding training, transparent conflict disclosure and supervised teaching practice.
trainer_pathway.yatharth_mudra: Not a prerequisite and not sufficient by itself.
trainer_pathway.train_the_trainer: May be granted only after separate observed teaching assessment and periodic review.
trainer_pathway.scale_target: Any cohort or trainer count is a planning target, not a verified outcome; publish actual enrollment, completion, competency and complaint metrics.

longitudinal_practice.rule: Longitudinal reflection may support learning but must not require continuous availability, deprivation, fasting, isolation or proof of uninterrupted service.
longitudinal_practice.missed_periods: Record context and support needs without punitive scoring.

metrics.privacy: Publish aggregated, de-identified counts only when re-identification risk is acceptably low.

legal_boundary: This curriculum is a proposal for voluntary education. It does not create a court, judicial role, accredited institution, statutory qualification, public authority or funding.
